references.text: Describes how the Lord gave Libnah into Israel's hand, which verse 32 refers to as a pattern for the conquest of Lachish
Describes Israel's arrival at Lachish and the beginning of the siege that is completed in verse 32
The same wording about conquest and destruction is used regarding Eglon, showing the repeated pattern in Joshua's conquests
The same wording is used regarding Hebron, confirming the standardized pattern of God handing over cities to Israel
Lachish is mentioned in the list of kings whom Joshua and Israel struck, confirming the conquest described in Joshua 10:32
Amaziah fled to Lachish, the city that had previously been conquered by Joshua
God's promise to hand over the peoples of Canaan to Israel, which is fulfilled in the conquest of Lachish
The same expression about striking with the edge of the sword is used at the conquest of Jericho
